title: Business Context and Use
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
Business Context and Use

This inbound service operation receives a business partner’s credit rating, calculated and sent by your credit management system,
to your contract accounting system.

Related Operations

The Respond Credit Rating Query outbound service operation sends the requested information from the Credit Management
process component.

Features

The Respond Credit Rating Query inbound service operation provides the credit rating and the credit risk class for the requested
party.

Error Handling

Forward Error Handling

The Respond Credit Rating Query inbound service operation supports Forward Error Handling (FEH). The following error
categories are used:

e DCE: Determination & Conversion Error

e PRE: Processing Error

For more information about the individual error categories, see the code list for the global data type LogltemCategoryCode .

Message Types

e FICA Rating Replicate Response

Notes on SAP Implementation
The software component CA-SOA-ESM-ERP-FIN and business process CREDAGYOO]1 are used to support forward error handling.
The inbound proxy implementation updates the following data in the Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable:

e Credit rating as sent from Credit Management (Table DFKKCRH)
e Credit Management Master Data (Table DFKKCMS)

e Trigger for a change to Contract Accounting after a change to Credit Management master data. (You use the trigger(s) in
the mass activity transaction FPBPCU).

The ValidityPeriod of the CreditRiskClass is not supported.
